verdict.rationale: Shortwave's MCP feature lets Shortwave's own internal AI connect OUT to external apps/servers (client-side), and its built-in assistant (powered by Claude models) can read/draft/send email natively — but there is no evidence that Shortwave exposes a documented server (MCP endpoint, API, or webhook) that lets an external agent like ChatGPT or a user's own agent connect IN to read/triage/draft/send mail through Shortwave. Probes for llms.txt, docs-md, and OpenAPI/swagger endpoints all returned 404, reinforcing the absence of a documented external-agent connection surface.
